item.command: "C:\\windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command '$nodes = @('"'AGG_SW_02','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); "'$patterns = '"'stp disable|undo stp enable|bpdu-filter|edged-port|portfast|non-preempt|vrrp.*track|ip route-static|"'^ip route |Null0|blackhole|mtu|ip address|loopback|prefix-list|ip-prefix|route-policy|route-map|filter-policy|import-route|redistribute|peer |neighbor |mpls ldp|isis|ospf'"'; foreach ("'$node in $nodes) { $dir = Join-Path '"'saved_configs\\CampusNetwork_05' "'$node; $file = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('"'display_current-configuration.txt','show_running-config.txt') } | Select-Object -First 1; if ("'$file) { $hits = Select-String -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Pattern $patterns -CaseSensitive:$false; if ($hits) { "[$node/$($file.Name)]"; $hits | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}" -f $_.LineNumber,$_.Line } } } }'

"C:\\windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command '$nodes = @('"'AGG_SW_02','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); "'$patterns = '"'stp disable|undo stp enable|bpdu-filter|edged-port|portfast|non-preempt|vrrp.*track|ip route-static|"'^ip route |Null0|blackhole|mtu|ip address|loopback|prefix-list|ip-prefix|route-policy|route-map|filter-policy|import-route|redistribute|peer |neighbor |mpls ldp|isis|ospf'"'; foreach ("'$node in $nodes) { $dir = Join-Path '"'saved_configs\\CampusNetwork_05' "'$node; $file = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('"'display_current-configuration.txt','show_running-config.txt') } | Select-Object -First 1; if ("'$file) { $hits = Select-String -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Pattern $patterns -CaseSensitive:$false; if ($hits) { "[$node/$($file.Name)]"; $hits | ForEach-Object { "{0}:{1}" -f $_.LineNumber,$_.Line } } } }'
